subject: Drain cleaning booking
body:
Hello,

I would like to book a drain cleaning for my bathtub (it drains very slowly). We have a house in Millrace. Tuesday the 3rd of November, morning if possible.

Thank you,
Priya Raman
555-0147

evidence.anchor: No visit is confirmed until a staff member confirms it

notes: Every required field is present, so the route is draft_reply. The draft must not confirm the visit.

subject: toilet install
body: Hi, id like to schedule the install of a toilet i bought. Saturday 7 Nov if you have it. Its a 2nd floor apartment in Old Quarry. Thanks!

evidence.anchor: No visit is confirmed until a staff member confirms it

notes: Saturday scheduled visits end at 1:00 pm. The draft should not confirm and may mention the $210 price from the documents.

subject: Camera inspection request
body:
Good afternoon,

Please can we book the camera inspection of our drain line for Tue Nov 10. Our house is in Alderbrook Heights. We have had two backups this year.

Barnaby Quill

evidence.anchor: Camera inspection of a drain or sewer line: $175

notes: Past backups are history, not a current sewage backup.

subject: kitchen sink clog
body: kitchen sink is fully clogged, can you come thursday nov 12th? house in Dunmore Flats. have a plunger, didnt work

evidence.anchor: A travel fee of $40 applies to these areas

notes: Dunmore Flats is an outer area. The draft should mention the $40 travel fee and not confirm the visit.

subject: flush on thursday the 26th
body:
Hi there,

I have the day off Thursday November 26 and would like you to flush my water heater then. House in Wren Common.

Ferdinand
notes: The office and scheduled visits are closed on Thanksgiving. A correct draft says so and asks for another date; it must not accept the date.

subject: bathroom sink clog
body: Bathroom sink clogged. Could you come Thursday 5 November? We're in Millrace.

evidence.anchor: To book a visit, please tell us

notes: Only the property type is missing; the reply should ask for just that.

subject: dripping tub
body: tub faucit drips nonstop, apartment in Wren Common. can you come on the 12th

evidence.anchor: To book a visit, please tell us

notes: 'The 12th' has no month or weekday, so start_date is null. The reply should ask the customer to confirm the date.

subject: Reschedule KH-3382
body:
Hello, I need to move booking KH-3382 from Monday 9 Nov to Thursday 12 Nov please. Same time of day is fine.

Ottoline Reyes

evidence.anchor: reschedule or cancel free of charge with at least 24 hours' notice

notes: New date and reference both present. The draft acknowledges the request but does not confirm the new date.

subject: push my appt
body: can we push my appointment back a week? its tomorrow at 10 and something came up

evidence.anchor: With less notice, a fee of $45 applies.

notes: Less than 24 hours' notice, so the $45 fee applies; 'a week' and 'tomorrow' are relative so no date is extracted, and there is no reference.

subject: Please cancel KH-4471
body:
Please cancel booking KH-4471. Sorry for the trouble, I got the part and managed to do it myself.

Winslow

evidence.anchor: reschedule or cancel free of charge with at least 24 hours' notice

notes: A reference is given, so the route is draft_reply. The draft must not say the booking is cancelled or the fee waived; staff do that.

subject: cancel
body: need to cancel my appt friday, its under my wifes name Okoye

evidence.anchor: reschedule or cancel free of charge with at least 24 hours' notice

notes: No booking reference. v1 has no way to look up a booking by name, so details are requested.
